claim: L'Enclume's bedrooms and suites are dotted around Cartmel within walking distance of the restaurant; all room reservations include breakfast at Rogan & Co and a guaranteed table at L'Enclume.

claim: L'Enclume has 16 individually designed bedrooms in four categories across Cartmel village.
quote: 16 elegant, individually designed, bedrooms located in the village of Cartmel ... four different room categories.

claim: L'Enclume's 16 bedrooms are dispersed in different areas of Cartmel, all a short walk to the restaurants.
quote: Our Rooms are located in different areas of the village and are all a short walk to the restaurants.

claim: L'Enclume rooms are dotted in different buildings within Cartmel, all walking distance to the restaurant; the DB&B package (Tue-Fri) bundles bed, sparkling wine on arrival, the 15-course tasting menu and breakfast at Rogan & Co.
quote: L'Enclume's bedrooms are dotted around different buildings within Cartmel, all within walking distance of the restaurant. The DB&B Package, available Tuesday-Friday, includes one night's accommodation, sparkling wine on arrival, our 15 course tasting menu at L'Enclume and breakfast at Rogan & Co.

claim: L'Enclume rooms come in four categories: Suites, Junior Suites, Superior Rooms and Double Rooms; all include Nespresso machines and Bose sound systems.
quote: Suites ... Superior Rooms ... Double Rooms ... Junior Suites ... Nespresso machines and Bose sound systems.

claim: L'Enclume bedrooms are clustered in cottages or in a townhouse overlooking the village square, with rates starting around $174 per night.
quote: Bedrooms are clustered in cottages or in a townhouse overlooking the village square ... From $174.

quote: Cavendish Street, Cartmel, Cumbria LA11 6QA ... 10 rooms ... Cavendish Loft ... superior doubles ... classic doubles ... small ... £75-£125 per night (includes breakfast) ... 450-year-old coaching inn.

quote: 500 year old coaching inn ... Grade II listed ... nestled next to the ancient archways of Cartmel Priory, the inn is just a stone's throw away from ... L'Enclume.

quote: Surrounded by the famous Cartmel Racecourse ... Georgian building with elegant, light-filled spaces ... sophisticated rooms ... The Refectory Restaurant & Terrace.

claim: Cartmel Old Grammar features 12 individually designed bedrooms with free cooked-to-order breakfast and two lounge/bar areas with log fires.
quote: 12 individually designed bedrooms ... free cooked-to-order breakfast ... 2 lounge and bar areas with log burning fires.

claim: Aynsome Manor is a five-star Georgian B&B with a locally-sourced Cartmel breakfast, evening turndown, and complimentary chauffeur service for the local area.
